<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a clear M+1 peak at ~5.6 % of the base peak and rapidly diminishing higher isotopes, with no significant M+2 peak that would indicate chlorine, bromine, or sulfur—the only element whose presence can be definitively inferred is carbon (the M+1 intensity matches the expected contribution from several carbon atoms). No other element shows a characteristic isotopic signature in this spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
